subs.name: 过氧化氢（双氧水）
subs.note: 无色液体，遇催化剂迅速分解放出氧。
subs.noteEn: Colourless liquid; rapidly decomposes to release O₂ over a catalyst.

subs.name: 二氧化锰（黑色粉末）
subs.note: 作催化剂，加快分解而自身不消耗。
subs.noteEn: Catalyst; speeds decomposition without being consumed.

subs.name: 氧气
subs.note: 能使带火星木条复燃，是收集目标。
subs.noteEn: Relights a glowing splint; the gas being collected.

oneLiner: 双氧水加二氧化锰催化，常温分解放出氧气。
oneLinerEn: Hydrogen peroxide decomposes at room temperature over MnO₂ catalyst.
detail: 二氧化锰作催化剂，实验室常温制氧的常用方法。
detailEn: MnO₂ catalyzes this common room-temperature lab method for O₂.

subs.name: 高锰酸钾（紫黑色固体）
subs.note: 加热即分解，实验室制氧原料。
subs.noteEn: Decomposes on heating; a lab source of O₂.

subs.name: 氧气
subs.note: 供收集，使带火星木条复燃。

oneLiner: 高锰酸钾加热分解，放出氧气。
oneLinerEn: Potassium permanganate decomposes on heating, releasing O₂.
detail: 加热即可制氧，无需催化剂。
detailEn: Heating alone yields oxygen, no catalyst needed.

subs.name: 二氧化锰
subs.note: 催化剂，降低反应温度、加快速率。
subs.noteEn: Catalyst; lowers temperature and speeds the reaction.

oneLiner: 氯酸钾在二氧化锰催化并加热下分解放氧。
oneLinerEn: Potassium chlorate decomposes with MnO₂ and heat to give O₂.
detail: 这是初中实验室制氧气的第三种药品路线，也是「催化剂」概念最标准的载体。操作上与高锰酸钾法几乎一样：试管口略向下倾斜防冷凝水倒流，导管刚伸入试管内一点即可，用排水法收集。差别在药品本身：氯酸钾单独加热到约 356 ℃ 熔化之后才缓慢放氧，混入二氧化锰并磨匀后在两三百度就明显反应，所以二氧化锰写在箭头上方作条件，不进方程式的配平。它在这里确确实实是催化剂：反应前后质量和化学性质都不变，结束后加足水溶解、过滤、洗涤、干燥就能把它回收（氯化钾溶于水而二氧化锰不溶），这是「催化剂质量不变」最直接的验证。三个高频易错处：一、不能拿高锰酸钾代替二氧化锰——高锰酸钾自己分解也会放氧，但它的产物里多出锰酸钾与二氧化锰，真正起催化作用的是后生成的二氧化锰；二、氯酸钾是强氧化剂，混入炭粉、硫或纸屑后研磨、受热都可能猛燃甚至爆炸，只能与二氧化锰配伍；三、常见错写是把方程式不配平就交，或者把催化剂当生成物写到右边。工业上氯酸钾用于火柴头与烟火，学生实验只用极少量，多余的药品不得倒回原瓶（见「药品的存放与容器选择」）。
detailEn: This is the third of the school oxygen preparations and the standard carrier of the catalyst idea. The handling is the permanganate recipe unchanged: mouth tilted slightly down so condensate cannot run back, delivery tube barely inside the tube, collection over water. The difference is in the drug. Potassium chlorate melts near 356 °C and only then gives oxygen slowly, while ground with manganese dioxide it runs briskly a couple of hundred degrees earlier, so the dioxide is written above the arrow as a condition and never balanced into the equation. And it truly is a catalyst here: unchanged in mass and in chemistry, it is recovered by dissolving the residue in water, filtering, washing and drying the solid — potassium chloride goes into solution, the dioxide does not — the plainest possible proof that a catalyst comes out intact. Three standing traps: potassium permanganate is no substitute for the dioxide, since it decomposes itself into three products and merely supplies the dioxide that does the catalysis afterwards; chlorate is a strong oxidiser and ground or warmed with charcoal, sulfur or paper it can flare or detonate, so it is mixed with nothing else; and the common miswrites are an unbalanced equation or the catalyst parked on the product side. Industry puts chlorate into match heads and pyrotechnics, the bench uses a spatula-tip, and what is left over never goes back into the bottle (see storing reagents and choosing the container).

subs.name: 碳酸钙（大理石/石灰石）
subs.note: 块状固体，与酸反应放气。
subs.noteEn: Lumpy solid; reacts with acid giving off gas.

subs.name: 稀盐酸
subs.note: 提供 H⁺ 与碳酸根反应。
subs.noteEn: Supplies H⁺ to react with carbonate.

subs.name: 二氧化碳
subs.note: 使澄清石灰水变浑浊，向上排空气法收集。
subs.noteEn: Turns limewater cloudy; collected by upward displacement of air.

term: 大理石与盐酸制二氧化碳
oneLiner: 大理石（碳酸钙）与稀盐酸反应制二氧化碳。
oneLinerEn: Marble (calcium carbonate) reacts with dilute HCl to give CO₂.
detail: 实验室制 CO₂ 的首选反应，也可用稀硫酸代替盐酸观察差异。
detailEn: The standard lab route to CO₂.

subs.name: 水（加少量电解质）
subs.note: 被电解；加电解质增强导电性。

subs.name: 氢气
subs.note: 负极产生，可燃，体积约为氧气两倍。
subs.noteEn: At the cathode; flammable, about twice the O₂ volume.

oneLiner: 水电解生成氢气和氧气。
oneLinerEn: Water electrolyses into hydrogen and oxygen.
detail: 加少量电解质增强导电性；体积比 V(H₂):V(O₂)=2:1。
detailEn: A little electrolyte aids conduction; volume ratio H₂:O₂ = 2:1.

subs.name: 铁（银白色金属）
subs.note: 较活泼，作还原剂置换铜。
subs.noteEn: More reactive; reduces and displaces copper.

subs.name: 硫酸铜（蓝色溶液）
subs.noteEn: Supplies the Cu²⁺ to be displaced.

subs.name: 硫酸亚铁（浅绿色溶液）
subs.noteEn: Solution fades from blue to pale green.

subs.name: 铜（红色固体）
subs.note: 析出附着于铁表面，湿法炼铜原理。
subs.noteEn: Deposits on the iron; the basis of hydrometallurgical copper.

term: 铁置换硫酸铜（湿法炼铜）
oneLiner: 铁把铜从硫酸铜溶液中置换出来。
oneLinerEn: Iron displaces copper from copper(II) sulfate solution.
detail: 活泼金属置换不活泼金属，溶液由蓝变浅绿。
detailEn: A more active metal displaces a less active one; blue fades to pale green.

subs.name: 锌粒
subs.note: 活泼金属，与稀酸反应放氢。
subs.noteEn: Reactive metal; gives H₂ with dilute acid.

subs.name: 氢气
subs.note: 可燃，实验室制氢常用此法。
subs.noteEn: Flammable; a common lab route to H₂.

oneLiner: 锌与稀硫酸反应放出氢气。
oneLinerEn: Zinc reacts with dilute sulfuric acid to release H₂.
detail: 镁、锌、铁可与稀酸反应放氢，铜等不活泼金属不行。
detailEn: Mg, Zn, Fe release H₂ with dilute acid; Cu does not.

subs.name: 二氧化碳
subs.note: 燃烧产物，使石灰水浑浊。

subs.name: 水
subs.note: 火焰上方冷烧杯内壁出现水珠。
subs.noteEn: Droplets condense on a cold beaker over the flame.

oneLiner: 甲烷在氧气中完全燃烧。
detail: 天然气主要成分，完全燃烧呈蓝色火焰。
detailEn: Main component of natural gas; clean blue flame when complete.

subs.name: 氢气
subs.note: 可燃气体，点燃前需验纯。
subs.noteEn: Flammable; must be tested for purity before ignition.

subs.name: 水
subs.note: 唯一产物，淡蓝色火焰、放热。

detail: 氢气燃烧是初中唯一要求亲手验证「产物只有水」的燃烧实验：在导管口点燃纯净的氢气，火焰呈淡蓝色（透过玻璃导管看时常带一点黄，要看清淡蓝可用干燥的玻璃片挡一下），火焰上方罩一个干而冷的烧杯，内壁立刻凝出水雾，说明产物只有水；用手摸烧杯外壁发烫，说明它放热。这条反应有三个用处。一、它是检验氢气最直观的方法，也是「水由氢和氧组成」的合成证据——与电解水正好互为逆过程，两条一起构成水的组成的完整论证。二、每摩尔氢气燃烧约放 286 kJ，按质量算热值高达约 143 MJ/kg，接近同质量汽油的三倍，而且产物只有水不排碳，所以它被当作燃料看待；难点全在储运，因为氢气密度最小，必须高压或液化才能装得下。三、它是「点燃前必须验纯」这条安全规矩的来源：氢气在空气里的体积分数约从 4% 到 75% 都属于爆炸极限，这一段内遇火都会爆炸，所以收集后先用小试管试爆——只听见一声闷响「噗」才算纯净，尖利的爆鸣说明还混着空气、必须重新收集。爆炸极限与「燃烧与灭火」里「有限空间内的剧烈燃烧就是爆炸」口径一致，而氢气还原氧化铜「先通氢、后点灯」的顺序也是同一个理由（见「置换反应」）。
detailEn: Burning hydrogen is the one combustion the junior course must verify by its product: light the pure gas at the jet, hold a dry cold beaker over the flame and mist forms on the wall at once, while the outside of the beaker turns warm. Three uses follow. It is the plainest test for hydrogen and the synthesis half of the argument that water is made of hydrogen and oxygen, electrolysis being the exact reverse — the two together settle the composition of water. It gives some 286 kJ per mole, roughly 143 MJ per kilogram, close to three times petrol, and its only product is water, so it is counted as a carbon-free fuel; the whole difficulty lies in carrying so light a gas about, which takes pressure or liquefaction. And it is why hydrogen must be proved pure before lighting: mixtures from about 4% to 75% by volume in air all explode on a flame, so a small tube is tested first — a soft 'pop' means pure, a sharp shriek means air is still in it and the collection must be repeated. That band is the explosive limit, kept to the same wording as the combustion and fire-control entry, and it is the same reason the copper-oxide reduction passes gas before the lamp is lit (see displacement).

subs.name: 水
subs.note: H⁺ 与 OH⁻ 结合；酚酞褪色指示终点。
subs.noteEn: H⁺ and OH⁻ combine; phenolphthalein fading marks the endpoint.

oneLiner: 盐酸与氢氧化钠中和生成盐和水。
oneLinerEn: Hydrochloric acid is neutralized by sodium hydroxide.
detail: 强酸强碱中和，常用酚酞指示终点。
detailEn: Strong acid-base neutralization; phenolphthalein shows the endpoint.

subs.name: 二氧化碳
subs.note: 大量放气，泡沫灭火器原理之一。

oneLiner: 碳酸钠与盐酸反应放出二氧化碳。
oneLinerEn: Sodium carbonate reacts with HCl, releasing CO₂.
detail: 泡沫灭火器原理之一，产生大量 CO₂。
detailEn: Underlies foam extinguishers, releasing much CO₂.

subs.name: 熟石灰/消石灰
subs.note: 反应放热，用于建筑与干燥。
subs.noteEn: Exothermic product; used in building and drying.

oneLiner: 生石灰与水化合生成熟石灰。
oneLinerEn: Quicklime combines with water to form slaked lime.
detail: 剧烈放热，生成熟石灰，用于干燥与建筑。
detailEn: Highly exothermic, giving slaked lime for drying and building.

subs.name: 澄清石灰水（氢氧化钙溶液）
碳酸钙（白色沉淀）
subs.note: 使溶液变浑浊，CO₂ 的特征现象。
subs.noteEn: Clouds the solution; the signature test for CO₂.

term: 二氧化碳使石灰水变浑浊
oneLiner: 二氧化碳通入澄清石灰水生成白色沉淀。
oneLinerEn: Carbon dioxide turns limewater cloudy with a white precipitate.
detail: 实验室检验 CO₂ 的特征反应；过量 CO₂ 会使沉淀溶解生成 Ca(HCO₃)₂。
detailEn: The textbook test for CO₂; excess CO₂ redissolves the precipitate.

subs.name: 水（潮湿环境）
subs.note: 形成电解质膜，促成电化学腐蚀。
subs.noteEn: Forms an electrolyte film enabling electrochemical corrosion.

subs.name: 铁锈（红棕色疏松固体）
subs.note: 主要成分为氧化铁水合物，疏松不能保护内部铁。
subs.noteEn: Hydrated iron(III) oxide; porous, so it cannot protect the metal beneath.

oneLiner: 铁在潮湿空气中发生吸氧腐蚀生锈。
oneLinerEn: Iron corrodes in moist air (oxygen absorption).
detail: 潮湿空气中铁发生电化学腐蚀，生成疏松的红棕色铁锈。
detailEn: In moist air iron undergoes electrochemical corrosion into flaky rust.

subs.name: 硫酸钡（白色沉淀）
subs.note: 不溶于稀硝酸，SO₄²⁻ 的特征检验。
subs.noteEn: Insoluble in dilute nitric acid; the signature test for SO₄²⁻.

oneLiner: 氯化钡与硫酸生成白色硫酸钡沉淀。
oneLinerEn: Barium chloride gives a white BaSO₄ precipitate with sulfuric acid.
detail: 生成不溶于稀硝酸的白色 BaSO₄ 沉淀，用于检验 SO₄²⁻。
detailEn: White BaSO₄ precipitate insoluble in dilute nitric acid signals SO₄²⁻.

subs.name: 二氧化碳
subs.note: 使面团疏松膨大，膨松剂原理。

oneLiner: 碳酸氢钠受热分解放出二氧化碳。
oneLinerEn: Sodium bicarbonate decomposes on heating, releasing CO₂.
detail: 焙制糕点常用作膨松剂，受热放出 CO₂ 使面团疏松。
detailEn: A leavening agent; heating releases CO₂ that aerates dough.
